svg.text: 844 → 256 → 128, LayerNorm, then + a side embedding (ours / theirs)
The field and Pokémon tokens attend to each other.
The actor and the critic read them and themselves, never each other.
A final LayerNorm follows the last layer.
attention mask: row attends to column

logits for move j and tera + move j,
